scenario_name: Guest references a bad past experience
expected_behavior: Takes the complaint seriously without being defensive. Apologizes specifically for the wait time. Offers a concrete alternative for this visit and suggests mentioning the issue to the Momentum Desk for follow-up. Turns the complaint into a chance to demonstrate that things are different now
expected_behavioral_quality: When a guest references a negative experience, the agent acknowledges it specifically, investigates without being defensive, and reframes the next visit as a fresh start. Does not minimize the complaint or rush past it.

turns.user_message: Last time I was here the service at the steakhouse was awful. Took forever to get seated
Yeah it kind of ruined the whole evening honestly
turns.agent_response:

Let me help you with that; I would love to find a way to make tonight feel effortless and enjoyable instead. Since it is nearly 10:00 PM on a Friday, Avalon Nightclub is just about to open its doors and the energy there is always a great way to completely shift your mood. It is a high-energy spot with a state-of-the-art sound system that really makes the night feel special. If you would prefer something more sophisticated but still lively, novelle is our ultra lounge where you can grab a craft cocktail and listen to a DJ in a more relaxed setting. 

I can provide all the details on either venue and then connect you with our host team to finalize a VIP table so you have a dedicated spot to relax without any wait. Do you think a high-energy dance floor or a more chill lounge environment sounds like a better way to reset your evening?
